meta.title: Cost Center Master & Hierarchy Mapping: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role and verify that Cost Center Master & Hierarchy Mapping is refused or absent.
Sign in as a Tenant Admin and verify that the same Cost Center Master & Hierarchy Mapping action is available and can maintain the hierarchy.
Compare the two role outcomes in the same tenant.
